reason: The crash handler's last-resort print before exit; lib/ui/out.ts imports this module, so it cannot import out.
The daemon's own stderr capture: it replaces process.stderr.write so stray writes land in the daemon log, and reports its own init failure where no logger exists yet.
Parses escape sequences in a captured pane to read the text under them; it prints nothing.

The language server hands process.stdout to vscode-languageserver as its LSP channel and writes nothing itself; without explicit streams the library needs --stdio in argv, which a client need not pass.
